_readme: Fill this in to put your name on the site: the home page "Who's behind it" card, the footer About link and the About page (which also becomes searchable). The "Bake proof" GitHub action writes it into the pages. name: your name. photo: a square photo, e.g. "site/img/founder.jpg" (about 600 x 600). story: three sentences on why you built it, in your own words (blank line between paragraphs). links: one profile, e.g. [{ "label": "X", "url": "https://x.com/you" }] or YouTube or LinkedIn.
name: J.P. Gentry
role: Online fitness coach. Edits his own reels with Reel Studio.
story:
I coach fitness online, and my reels are me talking to a camera in a budget home gym: one take, and a clap whenever I flub a line so I can say it again.

Editing each one took longer than filming it, and the AI tools I tried turned my reels into the same flashy, captions-bouncing stuff everyone else posts.

So I built Reel Studio to edit the way I would by hand: cut the flubs and dead air, caption what I actually said, add real footage and music, and stop there.
